invariants.rationale: The method directly dereferences 'result', so it must not be null at this point.
'result.getWriteStatuses()' is used to construct the commit metadata, so it must not be null.
'result.getPartitionToReplaceFileIds()' is used in the buildMetadata call; it must not be null.
The method sets the commit metadata, so at exit it should be present.
The method constructs commit metadata from the stream of write statuses, which implies it is not empty.
